title: Antonio C NDE3638 NDE 3638
content: I cannot remember why I lost control of my motorbike. I remember I was riding quite fast on my way home. Suddenly I had to get around a car that came into the street with no lights (this was at night). After passing by the car, I can't remember anything else. I would assume that I would have had time to break, reduce my speed, and continue on my way home with no problem. Instead, I remember talking to myself saying that I had really messed up big time. I cannot remember how it happened, how I felt on the ground, nothing. I just remember that I got into a big space with no limitations (no walls) dark with small yellow lights (lots of them). I could see two people sitting on a big table. I walked towards these two men but the distance remained the same. I remember these men were wearing purple coveralls with a strange symbol in the middle of the chest. I figure that they would be Jesus and St. Peter. I moved towards them and for some reason I sat on a chair in front of them without any word said by anybody. At a certain moment, I heard somebody walking behind me and both of the men looked to see who it was. Before I could look back St. Peter called me and we moved and suddenly we turned left, I looked back to see who was coming (could not see) and I remember calling my wife telling her about the accident. During this time, I remember talking to myself that I was dead. For sure, I was dead once I was meeting Jesus and St. Peter. I was surprised being in a dark place as I thought heaven was blue with angels playing music. I was not scared at any time, actually I felt myself playing around with myself saying how bad the accident was that I ended up being there. It was very weird mainly because I do not believe on these things and I am not religious.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: He 'figure[d]' the two men were 'Jesus and St. Peter.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'big space with no limitations (no walls) dark with small yellow lights (lots of them).' A 'big table' with two people sitting at it; he sat on a chair in front of them.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorbike accident after avoiding a car with no lights at night.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: He says he 'do[es] not believe on these things' and is 'not religious.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reports calling his wife during the experience; he encountered (as he interpreted) Jesus and St. Peter; no tunnel/OBE/life review/boundary described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He describes sudden arrival into a dark, expansive space with small yellow lights and two men at a table; later movement ('we moved and suddenly we turned left') and calling his wife.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two men in 'purple coveralls' with 'a strange symbol in the middle of the chest'; he walked toward them but 'the distance remained the same.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “a big space with no limitations (no walls) dark with small yellow lights (lots of them)”; “I walked towards these two men but the distance remained the same.”; “During this time, I remember talking to myself that I was dead.”
